title: Flawed Helldusk Armour

sources.title: Lesser Infernal Retribution
markers: | description = When you are hit by a foe within {{Dist|m=2|ft=7}}, it might take {{DamageText|1d4|Fire}} damage.

summary: Heavy Armour with AC 18 and Stealth disadvantage. Take 1 less Piercing damage. When a foe attacks you in melee, it makes a DC 13 Dexterity save or takes 1d4 Fire.

fields.Lesser Infernal Retribution: Occurs per qualifying attack. The log can attribute the save to the wearer even though the attacker rolls it. The source reports melee only despite the listed 7 ft range.
fields.Crafting: Give Dammon the first Infernal Iron for the armour.
fields.Base value: 3200 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay use and reviewed pinned source evidence.
